name: Form 3 Mathematics: Quadratic Equations
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to solve quadratic equations by factorisation
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to form quadratic equations from word problems
learningActivities: Demonstration: teacher solves x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 by factorisation
Guided practice: learners solve quadratic equations on the board
Application: learners solve word problems leading to quadratics
keyPoints: A quadratic equation has the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0
To factorise, find two numbers that multiply to c and add to b
commonMisconceptions: Forgetting that the equation must equal zero before factorising
Errors in the signs of factors
lessonEvaluation: Learners solve five quadratic equations and one word problem. Teacher marks and gives feedback.
teacherReflection: Most learners solved correctly. Emphasise checking answers by substitution.
